question: What range of manifestation arises from the emission of will?
premises: Will can emit or project manifestation.
Manifestation spans a graded range of levels.
This range extends from kālāgni up to śiva.
inference: Therefore, from the emission of will, what is created extends from kālāgni up to śiva.
uncertainties: ākālāgni is read as indicating the lower limit beginning with kālāgni.
plain_english: From the emission of will, creation extends from kālāgni up to śiva.
